exchanges.answer: Cafeteria Staff can claim, prepare, and fulfil catering orders assigned to their outlet from their Inbox, track the orders they are working on or have completed, and see the events they have saved, registered for, or are awaiting approval on in My Events.

exchanges.q: what can a Student do in this app?
exchanges.answer: Students can submit event proposals, save drafts, and track their submissions. They can also discover and join clubs, manage their club memberships and presidencies, and view their club request history. Additionally, students are able to browse and register for published events, manage their own event registrations, and see the events they have created.

exchanges.q: is Club Admin able to delete clubs?
exchanges.answer: Yes, the Club Admin role can delete clubs.

As a Cafeteria Admin, you can create and manage all cafeteria outlets, oversee their menus, assign and manage staff across all outlets, and review the full staff-action history. Let me know if you would like help with any of those tasks.
